extractions.value: Paraneoplastic SPS associated with thymoma type B3. Tonic eye deviation to the left with restriction of extraocular movements to the right. At follow-up, slow saccades and impaired smooth pursuit persisted despite improvement in tonic eye deviation. Anti-GAD, anti-amphiphysin, and anti-acetylcholine receptor antibodies were negative. The patient satisfied all Dalakas clinical criteria except for negative anti-GAD antibodies.
extractions.quote: Thus, despite absence of anti-GAD antibodies, a diagnosis of paraneoplastic SPS was made... At follow-up, this patient had improvement in tonic eye deviation but slow saccades and impaired smooth pursuit persisted.
